usage: Common noun for a professional engineer, especially someone who works in building, civil, mechanical, electrical, or software fields.
Often used as a job title after a company name or with a field, such as civil, electrical, or computer engineer in English.
Sounds neutral and everyday; it is the standard word you should use in both speaking and writing.
For learner use, remember it refers to the profession, not just someone who is good at fixing things.
